snippet.title: De la Espriella firma decreto sobre protestas: entrará en vigencia el 14 de octubre
snippet.description:
🔴 Colombia tendrá nuevas reglas para las protestas sociales desde este 14 de octubre. El presidente Abelardo de la Espriella firmó un decreto que establece ocho causales para dar por agotado el diálogo y contempla situaciones en las que la fuerza pública podrá intervenir sin completar todas las etapas de concertación.

Entre las disposiciones se encuentran el acompañamiento policial a cuatro metros de las manifestaciones y la ampliación de las conductas consideradas violentas, como el lanzamiento de objetos, los daños a la infraestructura pública y la retención de personas.

La medida entrará en vigor este miércoles 14 de octubre, fecha en la que está convocada la primera jornada de movilización nacional durante el actual Gobierno.

snippet.title: ÉRAMOS ASSIM… 🦇🔪🌅
snippet.description:
ÉRAMOS ASSIM… 🦇🔪🌅

📺 Em Missa da Meia-Noite (Midnight Mass, 2021), Erin Greene, interpretada por Kate Siegel, enfrenta a criatura numa das cenas mais angustiantes da série. Enquanto o vampiro se alimenta do seu sangue, ela percebe uma oportunidade de impedir que a ameaça vá ainda mais longe.

🦇 A criatura está concentrada em se alimentar. Erin, mesmo ferida, aproveita essa distração para cortar suas asas com uma faca. O movimento acontece de maneira discreta, tornando aquele momento uma mistura de desespero, coragem e determinação.

snippet.title: How long does it ACTUALLY take getting HEARING AIDS 🦻
snippet.description:
I’m SO proud of Ryan!!! 🥹❤️

I was genuinely surprised when he told me he wanted to make a HLDIAT about getting his hearing aids. In the past, he’s opened up to me about how embarrassed he felt about needing them and how much shame he carried around it. So seeing him not only embrace getting hearing aids but also willingly share that experience with the world to help others feel less alone. it makes me SO emotional. 🥹❤️

Last year, I earned my post-baccalaureate degree in Communication Sciences and Disorders where I spent a lot of time studying the ear, hearing loss and learning how to administer hearing tests
One thing my professors emphasized was that two of the biggest barriers preventing people from getting hearing aids are cost and stigma. So many people go without hearing healthcare because they feel embarrassed or ashamed of needing it.

And that breaks my heart, because hearing aids are healthcare. There is absolutely NOTHING shameful about needing help to hear. ❤️

That’s why this video means so much to both of us. We want to help normalize hearing aids, show people what the process actually looks like, and hopefully make someone out there feel a little less nervous about taking that step.

I’m just so proud of Ryan for being vulnerable and sharing something that made him feel insecure in the past🥹❤️

#procrastination #hearingaids #hearingtest #hardofhearing #costco

snippet.description:
Radiohead performed "Creep" on Late Night with Conan O'Brien in 1993.
The performance marked a memorable moment in the band's early American TV history. 

On September 14, 1993, Radiohead appeared on Late Night with Conan O'Brien as the show's first musical guests. At the time, the British band was promoting its debut album, Pablo Honey, which featured "Creep," the alternative rock hit that introduced millions of listeners to Thom Yorke's distinctive vocals and Jonny Greenwood's explosive guitar sound. 

Looking back, the performance captures Radiohead before the experimental albums and worldwide acclaim that would define their later career. "Creep" eventually became both their breakthrough hit and a song the band sometimes felt overshadowed their wider musical identity. 

Did you know Radiohead was Conan's first musical guest?
